Here we show that these dynamical correlations can be extended beyond the accessible numerical window without explicitly evolving the underlying many-body wavefunction. We introduce an autoregressive machine-learning framework that enables the extrapolation of dynamical spin correlations in both time and space beyond the reach of conventional numerical methods. arXiv:2508.20347v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological defects that form in a nonequilibrium second-order phase transition are presumably seeded by fluctuations of the order parameter in the vicinity of the critical point. Going beyond the conventional KZM focus on defect density, we show that a recurrent neural network can predict locations of topological defects from short-time dynamical data deep within the impulse regime. item.title: 用于非均质固体力学的变分物理信息图神经网络
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Aashay Rajan Yadav, Amiya Prakash Das, Ratna Kumar Annabattula
本文提出一种无标签的变分物理信息图神经网络（PI-GNN），通过离散化而非试探场表示材料非均质性，并在自适应共形网格图上最小化离散总势能。该方法无需罚项、界面权重或预设过渡宽度即可构造满足狄利克雷边界条件的界面表示。在二维和三维小应变弹性及有限应变Neo-Hookean超弹性测试中，其冯·米塞斯误差在广泛刚度对比范围内低于3.58%，但训练成本超过单次有限元求解一个数量级以上。

item.title: 生成式回放缓解量子架构搜索中的样本匮乏
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Akash Kundu, Amit Kumar Jaiswal, Sebastian Feld, Prayag Tiwari
本文提出GenQAS，一种由张量网络引导的强化学习框架，将固定的矩阵乘积态热启动与优先级生成式回放相结合。学习到的局部状态转移模型根据真实状态—动作种子生成合成电路转移，并在双重深度Q网络更新中与真实经验混合。6至12量子比特化学哈密顿量基准和15量子比特横场伊辛模型实验表明，该方法提升了固定预算下的成功概率；在12量子比特任务中相较被动回放最高提升7倍，在含噪6量子比特BeH2迁移实验中达到化学精度所需步数减少92.7%。

item.title: 用于交通流预测的动态融合大语言模型
item.description:

item.title: 具有非共线自旋-轨道耦合的扭转结构中的莫尔拓扑
item.description:

item.title: 一种用于对角加权矩阵函数的量子启发去量子化方法：应用于带优化随机特征的学习
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Natsuto Isogai, Mio Murao, Hayata Yamasaki

item.title: 可解释性助手：用于解释能源消耗模型的对话式可解释人工智能界面
item.description:
📚 arXiv

item.title: 知识体系综述：通过可解释人工智能对机器学习发起的隐私攻击
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Abdullah Caglar Oksuz, Anisa Halimi, Erman Ayday
本文系统梳理了利用机器学习解释实施模型提取、成员推断和模型反演的25项研究，并将属性推断视为部分反演。研究区分了模型知识与解释获取方式，归纳出目标模型发布、攻击者推导、二次披露、特权访问和已发布全局工件五种路径。分析表明，隐私风险取决于暴露的解释信号、获取方式、攻击目标及攻击者已有知识，因此解释隐私应被视为端到端的信息披露问题，并针对不同获取路径和受保护资产设计防御措施。

item.title: Skyrmion nucleus resolves the Landauer paradox
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jiyuan Yang, Denan Li, Shi Liu
arXiv:2609.11551v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric switching is among the most fundamental and widely studied symmetry-breaking processes in physics. However, the Landauer paradox asserts that an ideal single-domain ferroelectric should be kinetically unswitchable, because a three-dimensional reversed nucleus would carry a prohibitive depolarization penalty, leading to unphysically large coercive field (the electric field required to switch the polarization). Here we show that this long-standing paradox is resolved by topology. In defect-free PbTiO3, large-scale molecular dynamics simulations reveal that the intrinsic critical nucleus is a three-dimensional polar skyrmion. 👤 Samuel G. H. Brookes, IniOluwa C. Popoola, Fabian Berger, Kara D. Fong, Angelos Michaelides, Christoph Schran
